svg.aria-label: A weight-driven clockwork movement on a cast bedplate. A train of cog wheels runs from a barrel drum along the bed's diagonal to an escape wheel, whose pallets let it drop one tooth every forty seconds. Above the great wheel a pawl — the flag preventScreenSaver drops into it — can stop the train. In front, the stage-1 drum counts 600 seconds and trails a 30-tooth wheel that drives the stage-2 drum 10:1, so stage 2 turns once in 60 seconds. A back rail carries five stations: four plungers labelled power, hall, touch and rtc, and a fifth labelled accel, welded down because the Paperwhite 3 has no accelerometer. A cord leaves the barrel over a sheave and hangs a weight past the bed's edge; a network plug at the right drops out on suspend.
